description: This file defines a React component for suggesting user profiles in a chat application, including rendering user suggestions and handling autocomplete logic based on user input.

classes.name: SearchUserProvider
classes.description: A provider class that manages user autocomplete suggestions based on input text and team context.

methods.name: handlePretextChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in the input pretext to trigger user autocomplete.

methods.name: doAutocomplete
methods.description: Performs the autocomplete fetch and processes the results.

methods.name: allowDividers
methods.description: Indicates whether dividers are allowed in the suggestion list.
